text:
elaine: Quick follow-up from the all-hands — can we get concrete months for the Lighthouse work across API / Console / Optimize? teams need to schedule feature flags and evals.

sanjay: short answer: yes. aiming for a phased rollout across q3/q4, but happy to lay out month-level targets here.

anna: Lighthouse = API latency knobs + console UX for traffic shaping + Optimize cost-recs, right? Want to confirm scope so dates map correctly.

elaine: yep that's the scope we heard. also need the canary window length for Dedicated so infra can reserve capacity.

kevin: tagging a couple of constraints: SDK changes for streaming will land before API knobs, so SDK teams need ~4 weeks lead.

anna: proposed timeline (tentative): API latency knobs beta in Aug, Console traffic-shaping UX in Sep, Optimize cost-recs v1 in Oct. Canary runs Nov.

tomas: engineering note — API knobs depend on kernel routing patch; if that slips, API beta moves to Sep and everything shifts +1 month. current risk level: moderate.

elaine: can we mark which dates are firm vs contingent? customers ask for hard commitments.

sanjay: firm windows = canary start dates (we'll commit to Nov 1 for canary). everything else is target-based with contingency clauses.

anna: actionable: i'll post a brief roadmap doc with milestones + fallbacks by Friday. will include gating metrics for canary.

kevin: SDK team will block Aug 15- Sep 15 for integration testing. please avoid API contract changes in that window.

elaine: perfect — can you @announce in #eng-platform and ping partners once doc is up? also adding a short prompt set for Optimize evaluation.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: roadmap-doc-draft -> /eng-docs/lighthouse/roadmap-draft (created by anna)

anna: leaving this thread open for concrete asks. if anyone needs calendar invites for the sync, DM me. :thumbsup:
